site.name: GulfCrypto Fee & Transfer Index
site.tagline: What it costs to send USDT and BTC right now, and which exchange is cheapest to withdraw from.
site.footer_note: Informational only. Not financial advice. Fees change by the minute; always check the exchange before you send.
hub.title: Cost to send USDT right now
hub.h1: Cost to send $100 of USDT right now
hub.intro: Live network fees for a USDT transfer from your own wallet, on every chain Gulf users actually use. Exchange withdrawal fees are a separate thing: see the second table.
hub.exchange_title: Cheapest exchange for a USDT withdrawal, per network
hub.exchange_intro: What the exchange charges you to withdraw USDT (the exchange pays the network fee itself). Flat fees in USDT.
hub.btc_intro: For a typical 1-input, 2-output SegWit transaction ({vbytes} vB).
hub.combo_intro: Cheapest exchange + network pairs for a USDT withdrawal of this size (fee as a share of the amount).
wallet_vs_exchange.title: Two different fees
wallet_vs_exchange.wallet: Network fee: what you pay when you send from your own wallet (MetaMask, Trust, Phantom, Tonkeeper…). It changes with congestion.
wallet_vs_exchange.exchange: Withdrawal fee: what the exchange charges when you withdraw to a wallet. Usually a flat amount; the exchange pays the network.

method.title: Methodology
method.cadence: Network fees and prices: every 15 minutes. Exchange API fees: every 6 hours. Manual rows: checked weekly, dated.
method.cite_text: GulfCrypto Fee & Transfer Index, crypto.gulfarcade.com, retrieved {date}.
method.saudi_text: Saudi Arabia has no licensing regime for crypto exchanges. SAMA and the CMA have warned the public about dealing with unlicensed platforms. This site is informational only and does not recommend any service.
